description: Currency converter (ECB rates): Converts an amount between ~30 major fiat currencies using European Central Bank daily reference rates (frankfurter.dev, free, no key), latest or for a past date. Source: ECB via api.frankfurter.dev. Reference rates, not a dealable quote. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: amount, from, to, rate, result, date, source.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD for a historical rate (default latest)

name: x420_currency_convert
